productInfo.inTheBoxDescription: Device, USB-C charging cable, travel pouch and quick-start guide

productDescription.descriptionExtra: Every Spavio AI device is CE-certified, dermatologist-tested and selected with beauty professionals for real-world results, comfort and safety.
careSteps: • Charge fully before first use and start on the lowest intensity
• Apply to clean, dry skin unless the guide says otherwise
• Wipe treatment surfaces with a soft, damp cloth after each use
• Store in the travel pouch, away from heat and moisture
productDescription.careExtra: Need help getting started? Our care team will walk you through your first session and build a routine around your goals.

reviews.sarah: "I was sceptical, but after six weeks with the LED mask my skin looks calmer and more even. Ten minutes while I read — easy."
reviews.emma: "Beautifully made and so easy to use. The guide and the routine the team sent me made all the difference."
reviews.jessica: "Fast delivery, great packaging and the device feels premium. Already ordered a second one as a gift!"
